description: This file contains the implementation of the SavingsProductReadPlatformService interface, responsible for retrieving savings product data from the database. It includes methods for fetching all savings products, specific products by ID, lookup data, products by currency, and filtering by overdraft type, with SQL query logic and row mappers for mapping result sets to data objects.

classes.name: SavingsProductReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for sourcing savings product data from the database, equipped with methods to retrieve all products, specific products, lookup data, and filter by currency or overdraft type, using SQL queries and row mappers.

classes.name: SavingProductMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation to map SQL result set rows to SavingsProductData objects, including detailed field extraction and enumeration mapping.

classes.name: SavingProductLookupMapper
classes.description: A simplified RowMapper for mapping savings product lookup data (id and name).

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all savings products, considering branch-specific access if enabled.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Fetches savings product lookup data (id and name), considering branch-specific access.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific savings product by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookupByType
methods.description: Fetches savings product lookup data filtered by whether products support overdraft, with optional filtering.

methods.name: retrieveAllForCurrency
methods.description: Fetches all savings products with a specific currency code, considering branch-specific access.
